verdict.rationale: Official SDK and API surfaces are documented for building with Skills. The Claude Agent SDK, programmable in Python and TypeScript, has a dedicated skills page: you control which skills sessions can invoke, author skills as filesystem artifacts, and programmatically load plugins and Claude Code features. The Messages API takes skills via the `container` parameter, backed by a Skills API and a Skill Versions API for upload and management. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs (the runtime probe used a third-party `npx skills` installer, not an official SDK), and evidence of explicit client-SDK examples for the Skills upload/version endpoints.
